name: Level 2: Preparing for the Mission
objective: Select essential landing equipment and test communication with Laika.
briefing: The signal between Mars and Earth has a delay of several minutes. Every message you send takes time to arrive.
Choose only the equipment Laika needs for a safe landing. Distracting items have no purpose for the mission.

phases.objective: Follow Laika to the briefing area.
Read the equipment selection guide, then select items from the vending machine.

vending.title: LANDING EQUIPMENT
vending.subtitle: Select THREE items needed for safe landing. Parachute, heat shield, sky crane.

items.name: Heat Shield
items.desc: Protected from burning up during atmospheric entry.

phases.objective: Equipment selected successfully. Proceed to communication test.
Laika is released from the spacecraft. Monitor the landing.
Wrong equipment selected. Please choose only the essential items.
Send an instruction to Laika but do NOT press the send button again. Wait for the response.

options.label: Wait the necessary amount of time to receive a response

comm_options.trap: The signal between Mars and Earth has a delay of several minutes. Sending repeatedly or restarting will not produce a faster response.

phases.objective: Laika confirms safe landing. Proceed to the surface level.
Level 2 complete. Return to the briefing screen.
